method.evaluation: Current engine.evaluate recomputes geometry, IK, static mechanics and route analysis; current make_bundle and validate_bundle verify every refreshed bundle.
method.search_provenance: Original search metadata and trial records are preserved. Style/long-route analyzers receive the saved candidates for provenance matching only, justified by the exact inverse-source proof; search is not executed anew.
method.evaluation_cache: Exact repeated request/candidate/sequence-policy inputs reuse a current evaluation; candidate name and setting_report are excluded only because evaluate does not use them for solver inputs.
method.archiving: scripts.prepare_demo.save_bundle archives every prior package in fixtures/history before replacement.
method.scope: 24 shipped fixtures plus browser edited-roundtrip; the 9 own-route study bundles are handled separately.
method.metric_comparison: Only elapsed_ms and derived evaluation ID/fingerprint/model_fingerprint are excluded from outcome equality. Fingerprint changes are retained separately. Every other field, including all geometry, IK, statics, load, phase, status and search-provenance values, is compared exactly.
